title: The workbench GitHub page
text: One page in every mode: App installations with a Manage on GitHub link to repository-access settings, personal authorization when one is known, and project mappings. Hosted marks installation facts live. Local and self-hosted show when each installation was last checked; Check now runs projects.github_binding.check for every bound project in scope and names any refusal's reason and recovery. Facts the page cannot read are hidden, never shown as unavailable.
